reviews.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer[bot]
reviews.body: ## Pull request overview This PR hardens the `ensureNoResultsElement()` helper in the admin UI to prevent accidentally writing “no results” query text into an unrelated DOM node and to avoid creating duplicate `id` attributes after partial re-renders (e.g., HTMX swaps). **Changes:** - Validate that a globally-resolved `spanId` element is actually a descendant of the expected `msg` element before returning it (otherwise fall back to `msg.querySelector("span")`). - In the create path (when `msg` is missing), strip `id=spanId` from any stale existing element before creating a new span to prevent duplicate IDs. - Add regression tests covering both edge cases (wrong span returned; duplicate IDs). ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `mcpgateway/static/admin.js` | Adds containment guarding for `spanId` lookup and de-duplication of stale `spanId` before creating new elements. | | `tests/js/admin-edit-server-selection.test.js` | Adds targeted regression tests for the two reported DOM edge cases. | | `.secrets.baseline` | Regenerated baseline metadata / line number shifts (no functional code impact). | --- 💡 Add Copilot custom instructions for smarter, more guided reviews. reviews.author: marekdano
reviews.body:
### Summary of Changes

#### Problem
`ensureNoResultsElement()` had two DOM edge cases:
1. Global `getElementById()` could return a span from a different part of the DOM
2. Creating new elements without checking for stale IDs could produce duplicate IDs

#### Solution
1. Added `msg.contains(span)` guard to verify span is inside msg before returning it
2. Strip `id` attribute from any stale element before creating new span

Both fixes are minimal, targeted, and maintain backward compatibility.

This is a well-crafted fix that:
1. Correctly addresses both reported edge cases
2. Includes comprehensive regression tests
3. Maintains existing functionality
4. Follows project coding standards
5. Has minimal risk and no breaking changes

LGTM 🚀

reviews.author: marekdano
reviews.body:
This PR hardens `ensureNoResultsElement()` against DOM ID scoping bugs: when multiple search widgets share the same page, a globally-found spanId might belong to a different widget's msg, or exist as an orphaned stale element. 

The fix scopes span lookups to inside msg (with a `msg.contains()` guard) and strips stale span IDs before creating new elements. The `gateway.test.js` fixture is also corrected to match the actual DOM structure the function produces.

LGTM 🚀
